items.title: HTML files open as real pages
items.text: `ghoztty +split --view=mock/index.html` now renders the page instead of showing you its source. Its own CSS, JavaScript, images, and fonts run, links follow in the pane, and Back/Forward work across it — so a scaffolded mock or prototype is viewable straight from disk, with no `python3 -m http.server` standing in front of it. Saving the file re-renders it in place and keeps your scroll position, so you're not thrown back to the top of a long page. Assets are read from the page's own directory, so keep shared files under it; an edited sibling stylesheet needs `+reload`/Cmd+R to get past WebKit's cache.

items.title: The fork runs CI again
items.text: Pull requests build and test for real, with the Zig and Swift halves reported as separate steps so a failure points at the right half. Its first real run caught a remote-handshake bug plus two flaky viewer tests, all fixed in this release.
